notes: B-home and B-offer fully implemented with all required tests. Key decisions: (D1) Vehicle selector source: GET /vehicles is FleetAdminOnly — vehicle selector in DriverHomePage pre-populated from GetMe's currentVehicleId/currentVehiclePlate. selectedVehicleId synced via useEffect when meData arrives (fixes stale-closure initial-state bug). (D2) priceBadge.ts renamed to priceBadgeUtils.ts — on Windows, priceBadge.ts and PriceBadge.tsx differ only in case causing TS1261; dead priceUtils.ts shim deleted. (D3) NewOrderOffered and DriverStatusChanged use window CustomEvent bridge to avoid circular import between shared/realtime and driver/offer feature. (D4) useOwnStatusSync now imports normalizeDriverStatus from eventReducer.ts (single authoritative mapping: 0=Offline,1=Free,2=EnRoute,3=Busy) — eliminates a local duplicate with wrong order. (D5) Silent mode stored under key 'driver_silent_mode' in localStorage (default OFF for drivers). (D6) F-08 amendment: both 404 AND 409 on accept/decline → stale outcome → dismiss + toast. TypeError → offline outcome → stay open. (D7) Double-tap guard moved from useState (stale closure risk) to useRef for synchronous check-and-set. Duplicate tap returns 'noop' outcome (no UI side-effect). (D8) useOfferSound: separate refs for beep and vibrate intervals; vibrateStartedRef guards the stop(0) call to avoid spurious vibrate(0) when silent mode is ON. (D9) totalSeconds computed once on mount from (expiresAt - Date.now()) / 1000 stored in useRef — no hardcoded 45s, correct for any server-configured timeout. (D10) distance/ETA: one-shot navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition + GET /geo/route (feature-detected, degrades to null gracefully). Shown as distance/ETA chips above dropoff when available. (D11) Location permission check via navigator.permissions.query({name:'geolocation'}); 'denied' → hasLocation=false; API absent → optimistic true. (D12) hub+offer listener mounted in DriverHomePage; B-ride must hoist to DriverLayout so the hub stays alive during the ride. Future B-history-settings can provide a proper driver-accessible vehicle list endpoint.
